units: <cite ref="Berakhot 61b:1">Ber. 61ᵇ</cite> <he>ר׳ שואבת וכ׳</he> the lungs draw (resorb) all liquids.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 4">Lev. R. s. 4</cite> <he>הר׳ לשתיה</he> the lungs are the organ for drinking (resorbing liquids).

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 18">Lev. R. s. 18</cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:3">Koh. R. to XII, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 45a:11">Ḥull. 45ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="K00873"><he>כָּנָף</he></cite>.
